WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name as race_name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_average
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT 
  race_name,
  avg_points,
  avg_points - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as difference
FROM race_averages
WHERE avg_points > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
ORDER BY difference DESC    -- the rows it returns are your answer to that question
